name: 2026-10-11-sales-columns
note: Sales-floor columns from the owner's scan and photos: 6 columns in two straight rows of 3 (A-F); removed i44 and the steel pipe column, which the scan doesn't show.

set.name: Column (south row)
set.src: owner scan + photos 11 Oct, lined up
set.toConfirm: Owner, 11 Oct: the sales floor has 6 columns in two straight rows of 3, two of them on the garden/Simpson side of the Occidental row (owner photos). Placed from the owner's 6 Oct LiDAR mesh (my_scene.glb) with the scan-overlay glbToStore transform, re-checked against the sales-floor walls only (median 0.23 ft): floor-to-ceiling uprights at A 53.9/11.9, B 72.9/10.8, C 91.5/9.8, D 55.1/22.4, E 72.5/20.8, F 89.8/21.3, then put on shared straight lines (x 54.5, 72.6, 90.7; y 10.8 and 21.5) as the owner asked, so each is within about 1 ft of the scan. TO CONFIRM with a tape: one bay (about 18 ft east-west, 10.7 ft north-south).
